text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates computer science, mathematics, neuroscience and linguistics. Its core goal is to endow machines with the capabilities of "perceiving - learning - reasoning - decision-making". Its essence is to simulate human intelligent behaviors through algorithms. For instance, AlphaGo defeated the world champion of Go through deep learning, and Siri understood user instructions through natural language processing. Compared with traditional computer science, AI places more emphasis on "endowing machines with cognitive abilities" rather than merely executing preset programs.
